import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    # Build per-device watermark map from the snapshot (applied_event_ts).
    watermark_map = target.set_index("device_id")["applied_event_ts"]

    # Attach the device's current watermark (NaN/NaT if device is new).
    cdc = cdc.copy()
    cdc["_watermark"] = cdc["device_id"].map(watermark_map)

    has_watermark = cdc["device_id"].isin(target["device_id"])

    # Survival rule:
    #   existing device: event_ts STRICTLY greater than watermark survives
    #                     (equal == replay -> discarded, less -> late -> discarded)
    #   new device (no watermark): every event survives
    survive = pd.Series(False, index=cdc.index)
    if has_watermark.any():
        existing = cdc.loc[has_watermark]
        survive.loc[has_watermark] = existing["event_ts"] > existing["_watermark"]
    survive.loc[~has_watermark] = True

    surviving = cdc.loc[survive].copy()

    # Among surviving events per device, latest wins: order by (event_ts, event_seq)
    # descending, deterministic tie-break via stable sort (keeps original row order
    # for exact ties), then take the first row per device.
    surviving_sorted = surviving.sort_values(
        by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
        ascending=[True, False, False],
        kind="mergesort",  # stable sort for deterministic tie-breaking
    )
    winners = surviving_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="device_id", keep="first")

    winners = winners[["device_id", "reading", "event_ts"]].rename(
        columns={"event_ts": "applied_event_ts"}
    )

    # Merge winners onto the snapshot:
    #   - devices with a winning event get reading/applied_event_ts updated
    #   - devices with no surviving event carry forward unchanged
    #   - new devices (only present via winners) are added
    merged = target.merge(
        winners, on="device_id", how="outer", suffixes=("_old", "_new")
    )

    merged["reading"] = merged["reading_new"].combine_first(merged["reading_old"])
    merged["applied_event_ts"] = merged["applied_event_ts_new"].combine_first(
        merged["applied_event_ts_old"]
    )

    result = merged[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    return {"new_snapshot": result}
